manifest.name: dsh-remote-portal
manifest.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加远程访问能力，支持局域网和公网访问。Remote access for DeepSeek Harness: LAN and public access.
manifest.author: tsukii12

bundle.text:
# dsh-remote-portal — bundle patch.
#
# One host row. Its `config` is the *initial* configuration only: values changed in
# Settings → 远程访问 are persisted to <DSH_HOME>/dsh-remote-portal/state.json and
# take precedence on the next boot, so a toggle made in the panel never gets
# resurrected (or ignored) by this file.
#
# host:  0.0.0.0 listens on every interface; "auto" binds the primary LAN IPv4;
#        127.0.0.1 keeps the portal loopback-only (for an external tunnel).
# port:  the gateway listener, independent of the dsh Web port.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-remote-portal
      name: dsh-remote-portal
      config:
        enabled: true
        host: '0.0.0.0'
        port: 3081
        mobile: true
        auth:
          mode: password
          sessionDays: 30
          maxFailures: 5
          lockSeconds: 60

readme.text:
<div align="center">

**简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

**为 DeepSeek Harness 提供远程能力：局域网或公网远程访问。** [](LICENSE) [](#兼容性) [](#) [功能](#功能) · [安装](#安装) · [更新](#更新) · [公网访问](#公网访问) · [安全](#安全) · [常见问题](#常见问题) --- DeepSeek Harness 只监听 `127.0.0.1`，用一次性启动令牌认证——离开这台电脑就用不了。本插件不改动 dsh 的任何机制，只在它前面加一道自己的门：独立端口上的网关，先验密码或一次性配对码，再转发给本机 dsh。
面板是主区域里的一个页面（和「插件」「自动化任务」同级），侧栏保持可用。

| | |
|---|---|
| **局域网一条地址** | `http://<局域网IP>:3081/`，手机浏览器直接打开，不需要公网 IP 或端口映射 |
| **扫码配对** | 面板生成二维码，180 秒有效、一次即失效 |
| **公网访问** | 在**你自己的**服务器上跑中转，服务器主动拨出，得到稳定公网地址 |
| **密码与设备** | scrypt 加盐、连错锁定、逐台设备撤销 |
| **移动端重排** | 侧栏变抽屉、对话框不溢出、长代码/宽表格/大图不撑破页面 |
| **服务器目录选择器** | 「添加工作区」列出服务器上的目录，可逐级进入、可新建文件夹 |
| **零依赖** | 只用 Node 内置模块，无构建步骤 |

移动端
侧栏抽屉
服务器目录选择器

**从 DeepSeek Harness 安装（推荐）**：插件 → 添加插件 → 填入

```
https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal
```

**从命令行装**：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal
cd dsh-remote-portal
./install.sh            # macOS / Linux，装进 desktop + web profile
.\install.ps1           # Windows

使用国内镜像：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add \
  https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal/archive/refs/heads/master.tar.gz
```

装完**重启  DeepSeek Harness **即可。
**首次必做一步**：侧栏 → **远程访问** → 设置访问密码。在此之前门户不会监听局域网。

**先移除，再安装：**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-remote-portal
dsh plugin --profile desktop add    https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal
```

Web端把 `--profile desktop` 换成 `--profile web`。

更新后**必须重启 dsh**：宿主侧代码（`index.js`、`lib/*`）只在启动时加载，光刷新页面只换到客户端一半。

**锁定版本**：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal#v0.6.0
```

版本记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

在**你自己的**服务器上跑中转（单文件、零依赖）。一条命令：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal/master/tools/deploy-relay.sh | sudo bash
```

**国内网络**：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://ghfast.top/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal/master/tools/deploy-relay.sh | sudo bash

curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal@master/tools/deploy-relay.sh | sudo bash
```

脚本会自己下载 `relay.mjs`，探测环境、逐项提问（回车即默认），完成安装并注册 `drp` 命令。

**交互式设置**：console
$ drp
service     running · autostart on
uptime      2h 14m
agent port  1.2.3.4:9443 (TLS)
visitor     0.0.0.0:443 (TLS, self-signed)
endpoint    tls://1.2.3.4:9443
relay       reachable
tunnel      connected · 2 streams
traffic     in 8.0 MiB · out 7.9 MiB · 2140 requests · 3 clients
public      https://1.2.3.4/__t/ab12cd34ef56/
```

**更新中转**：再跑一次同一条命令即可——令牌与证书会复用，端口不会漂移。
面板里「中转服务器」只填 **`IP:端口`**（如 `1.2.3.4:9443`），协议自动识别（先试 TLS，失败回退明文）。完整部署见 [docs/DEPLOY-SERVER.md](docs/DEPLOY-SERVER.md)。

* 门户是唯一的门：没设密码就不会监听非回环地址。
* 会话 Cookie `dsh_portal`：`HttpOnly`、`SameSite=Lax`、绑定 UA，TLS 下自动 `Secure`。
* 门户自己的每个响应都带严格 CSP / `X-Frame-Options: DENY`；**被代理的 dsh 响应一个字节都不改**（有测试钉死）。
* 上游认证用宿主凭据在后台换取，令牌不出本机、不落日志、不回显面板。
* 明文 HTTP 下同网段可抓包看到 Cookie；介意就配 TLS 或走中转。

详见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

远程端某些按钮点了没反应？ 多数是只在桌面端有意义的入口（在资源管理器 / VS Code 中打开等）。
局域网打不开？ ① 面板状态是否「运行中」；② 手机与电脑是否同一网段；③ 防火墙是否放行端口；④ 监听地址是否为 `0.0.0.0` 或 `auto`。
公网地址打不开？ 一台中转可以接多台 dsh：`drp token add` 生成新令牌，`drp tokens` 列出所有隧道，`drp urls` 列出所有地址。 `drp status` 看隧道状态：`offline` 说明家里没连上中转（检查 9443 是否放行、令牌是否一致）；`connected` 但 503 说明反代缓冲（见部署文档排障表）。
撤销设备会踢掉 dsh 会话吗？ 不会。撤销只让那台设备的门户 Cookie 失效，底层 dsh 身份是多设备共享的。
`node --test` → **82 个测试**，约 75 秒，网络路径不 mock：门户用真实监听端口，隧道用真实中转 + 真实 agent（覆盖 HTTP、HTTPS、WebSocket），二维码由独立解码器校验，移动层跑在测试自己启动的 dsh 上。缺少 Chrome 时浏览器测试会显式跳过。

| | |
|---|---|
| dsh 版本 | `0.2.x`（在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上逐项验证） |
| profile | `desktop`（Electron）与 `web`（`dsh web`） |
| 系统 | Windows / macOS / Linux |
| 浏览器 | Chrome / Edge / Safari 15.4+ / Firefox 121+ |

- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) — 设计与实测宿主事实
- [docs/DEPLOY-SERVER.md](docs/DEPLOY-SERVER.md) — 服务端部署（systemd / Caddy / nginx / TLS）
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — 逐版本记录
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — 安全策略
* 只在同一网络内可达，公网访问需要服务器进行中转；不做 NAT 穿透。

<div align="center">

[简体中文](README.md) · **English**

**Remote access for DeepSeek Harness — over your LAN or through your own server.** [](LICENSE) [](#compatibility) [](#) [Features](#features) · [Install](#install) · [Update](#update) · [Public access](#public-access) · [Security](#security) · [FAQ](#faq) ---

DeepSeek Harness listens on `127.0.0.1` only and authenticates with a one-time launch token, so it is unusable from any other device. This plugin changes nothing inside dsh: it puts its own gate in front — a gateway on a separate port that asks for a password or a one-time pairing code, then forwards to dsh on loopback.
The panel is a page in the main column (a sibling of Plugins / Scheduled tasks); the sidebar keeps working.

| | |
|---|---|
| **One LAN address** | `http://<lan-ip>:3081/`, open it in a phone browser — no public IP, no port forwarding |
| **Scan to pair** | the panel draws a QR code: valid 180 s, single use |
| **Public access** | run the relay on **your own** server; the home machine dials out and gets a stable public URL |
| **Password and devices** | scrypt with a salt, lockout on repeated failures, per-device revocation |
| **Mobile layout** | the sidebar becomes a drawer, dialogs stop overflowing, wide tables and long code lines stop stretching the page |
| **Server-side folder picker** | "Add workspace" lists directories on the host, one level at a time, and can create one |
| **No dependencies** | Node built-ins only, no build step |

Phone (LAN)
Sidebar drawer
Server-side folder picker

**From inside dsh (recommended)**: Plugins → Add plugin → paste

```
https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal
```

**From a shell**:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal
cd dsh-remote-portal
./install.sh            # macOS / Linux, desktop + web profiles
.\install.ps1           # Windows

**Where GitHub is unreachable**, install from a mirror tarball instead of the URL above:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add \
  https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal/archive/refs/heads/master.tar.gz
```

Then **restart dsh** (quit and reopen the desktop app, or `Ctrl+C` and `dsh web`).

**One required step**: sidebar → **远程访问** → set an access password. Until one exists
the portal refuses to listen beyond loopback.

**Remove, then add** — repeating "add plugin" with the same source may not fetch new
code (pnpm answers `Already up to date` when the spec is unchanged):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-remote-portal
dsh plugin --profile web add    https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal
```

Use `--profile desktop` for the desktop app; run it once per profile you installed into.

**Restart dsh afterwards.** The host half (`index.js`, `lib/*`) only loads at startup;
reloading the page swaps just the client half.

> On a slow link `add` can fail with `ETIMEDOUT`. Run it again — what was downloaded is
> reused.

**Pin a version**:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal#v0.6.0
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for what changed.

Run the relay on **your own** server (one file, no dependencies). **No checkout
needed** — one command:

No Node? The installer installs a self-contained runtime itself (official tarball,
nothing added to apt/yum, kept in `/usr/local/lib/nodejs`) and carries on.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tsukii12/dsh-remote-portal/master/tools/deploy-relay.sh | sudo bash
```

```bash

readme.text:
**Updating the relay**: run the same command again — the token and certificate are
reused and the ports do not move. One relay can serve several machines: `drp token add` mints another token, `drp tokens` lists them and `drp urls` lists their addresses. `drp config K=V …` changes a saved answer and
reinstalls the unit; `drp uninstall` removes everything.

readme.text:
In the panel, the relay field takes an **`address:port`** (e.g. `1.2.3.4:9443`); the
transport is detected on connect (TLS first, plain TCP as fallback). Full guide:
[docs/DEPLOY-SERVER.md](docs/DEPLOY-SERVER.md).

* The portal is the only door: with no password set it refuses to listen beyond loopback.
* Session cookie `dsh_portal`: `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, bound to the user agent, and
  `Secure` automatically over TLS.
* Every portal response carries a strict CSP and `X-Frame-Options: DENY`; **proxied dsh
  responses are not modified at all** (a test pins this).
* The upstream cookie is minted in the background from a host credential; the token
  never leaves the machine, never reaches a log, and is never echoed in the panel.
* Over plain HTTP a sniffer on the same network can read the cookie. Use TLS, or go
  through the relay.
Details in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Some buttons do nothing when I'm remote? Usually they are entries that only make sense on the host's desktop (open in Explorer, open in VS Code, and similar).
The LAN address does not open? ① Is the panel state "running"? ② Is the phone on the same network? ③ Does the firewall allow the port? ④ Is the bind address `0.0.0.0` or `auto`?

The public URL does not open? `drp status` shows the tunnel: `offline` means the home machine never attached (check that 9443 is open and the token matches); `connected` with a 503 means a proxy is buffering (see the troubleshooting table in the deployment guide).
Does revoking a device end my dsh session? No. Revoking only invalidates that device's portal cookie; the underlying dsh identity is shared across devices.

| | |
|---|---|
| dsh | `0.2.x` (verified item by item on `0.2.1-rc.2`) |
| profiles | `desktop` (Electron) and `web` (`dsh web`) |
| systems | Windows / macOS / Linux |
| browsers | Chrome / Edge / Safari 15.4+ / Firefox 121+ |

`node --test` → **82 tests**, roughly 75 s, no mocks on the network paths: real listeners
for the gateway, a real relay plus a real agent for the tunnel (HTTP, HTTPS and
WebSocket), QR output checked by an independent decoder, and the mobile layer driven
against a live dsh that the suite starts itself. Browser tests skip explicitly when
Chrome is missing.

- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) — how it works, and the host facts behind it
- [docs/DEPLOY-SERVER.md](docs/DEPLOY-SERVER.md) — server deployment (systemd / Caddy / nginx / TLS)
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — per-release notes
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — policy

* Reachable on the local network only; public access needs a relay on a server you own.
  No NAT traversal.
